TRILHA.Config.SairAntes: The previous track leaves before the next one starts
TRILHA.Config.SairAntesHint: In sequential or shuffle playlists, picking another track fades the current one out completely (the playlist's Fade) and only then starts the new one, also fading in.
TRILHA.Config.Entrada: The new track starts when the fade-out reaches (%)
TRILHA.Config.EntradaHint: Where in the fade-out the next track begins. 100 = only once the previous is silent (a gap). 75 = in the previous track's last moments, the tails touch. 0 = at the same time (crossfade).
